redraft_closures.evidence: Re-verified from the full primary sources before changing anything; the pilot is right on both halves. JV-1998 (PRD 58, 064021) is a planar soliton in BULK 3He-A whose horizon exists ONLY above c_perp (Sec.V "The horizons appear in the moving soliton if v > c_perp"; Eq. (5.2)); Eq. (5.7) carries sqrt(1 - c_perp^2/v^2), so kappa -> 0 and T_H -> 0 as back-reaction slows the soliton toward c_perp FROM ABOVE, and Sec.VIII ("cools as it evaporates and approaches an extremal black hole") therefore AGREES with the equations. Read in the arXiv TeX (JacobsonVolovik1998.source/EventHorIn3He13Unix.tex lines 408, 452-453, 525-527, 707-713) and cross-checked in the published PDF Sec.VIII. The heating reasoning belongs to JK-2002, whose THIN FILM moves at v < c_perp with horizons at c(x_h) = +/- v and T_H(v) = T_H(0)(1 - v^2/c_perp^2) rising to the NON-ZERO T_H(0) = hbar c_perp / 2 pi d as radiation slows the wall (bhbu.tex lines 507, 550, 596-616, 652-654). The two 3He-A systems had been swapped. FIXED in fe154d98: BHThermodynamicsFourLaws.lean gains an "Attribution correction (2026-08-15)" docstring section retracting the claimed inconsistency and stating the soliton mechanism, and its References block moves JV-1998 to "a second cooling case, not a contrast case" with JK-2002 named as the sole heating contrast; CITATION_REGISTRY JacobsonVolovik1998 and JacobsonKoike2002 provides/notes rewritten accordingly. Blast radius closed in the same commit: paper27 Sec."The contrast case" no longer lumps JV-1998 in and gains a paragraph putting the soliton on the cooling branch; the BH_THERMODYNAMICS_PARAMS reference block in src/core/constants.py; docs/roadmaps/Phase6a_Roadmap.md Wave-5 anchor block and item O.3 both carry a dated superseding note. Lean side is DOCSTRING-ONLY: lean_deps.json has no docstring field, the module elaborates with zero diagnostics, and regime_partition_criterion still verifies on {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} - no theorem statement changed. Verify strengthened in 5a1f5167 from the filed absence-only form, which a deletion would have satisfied.

redraft_closures.evidence: Re-verified from the full TeX source; the pilot is right. Balbinot-Fagnocchi-Fabbri PRD 71, 064019 is not a condensate result. Abstract: "an acoustic black hole formed in a Laval nozzle under the assumption that the motion of the fluid is one-dimensional". Sec.IV, acusticpap.tex line 540: "Let us further assume the sound velocity c constant" - Eq. (Tsonic) is derived from that constant-c profile. Sec."The fate of the acoustic black hole", lines 1021-1023, verbatim: "In a similar way one can treat sonic black holes formed by a Bose-Einstein condensate [garayvisser]. The major difference comes from the fact that the sound velocity c is not constant, but proportional to rho^(1/2). This will be discussed elsewhere." (The file is ISO-8859 encoded, so a plain grep silently returns nothing on it - use grep -a with LC_ALL=C.) FIXED in fe154d98: the label is gone from BHThermodynamicsFourLaws.lean, src/bh_thermodynamics/{__init__,acoustic_evolution,four_laws_data,falsifier_checks}.py and src/core/citations.py, and the scope that replaces it is stated positively in the Lean overview, the Balbinot2005PRD registry entry, the acoustic_evolution module docstring, src/core/constants.py and papers/L3/bundle_metadata.json apex claims. Blast radius beyond the filed locations: D3 Sec.6 and F both attributed T_H(v) = T_H(0)(1 - v^2/c_perp^2) - the Jacobson-Koike HEATING law - to Balbinot as the anchor for the COOLING branch, sourced from a SECOND registry entry, Balbinot2005 (PRL 94, 161302, gr-qc/0405096), whose provides read "BEC analog Hawking T_H(v) = T_H(0)(1 - v^2/c_perp^2) ... cooling-toward-extremality" with primary_source_path and doi_verified both None. Three wrong claims on an entry no held source had ever backed. Both drafts now name Balbinot for the cooling sign and Jacobson-Koike for the thin-film contrast, and that registry entry carries no equation-level claim pending acquisition of gr-qc/0405096. Also corrected: the shipped figure trace name, axis title and page title in src/core/visualizations.py (re-rendered into figures/, papers/L3/figures/ and papers/paper27_.../figures/), the review_figures.py caption, src/wkb/backreaction.py (whose condensate evolution is the project OWN computation - the 2005 papers supply the sign, not the condensate equations), tests/test_bh_thermodynamics.py, docs/roadmaps/Phase6a_Roadmap.md, docs/RESEARCH_STATUS_OVERVIEW.md, papers/D3/SYNTHESIS_BRIEF.md and the claims-reviewer bundle prompt that instructed reviewers to expect a condensate anchor. Deliberately untouched: the APSEta/ modules substrate label, which is this project OWN condensate rather than a Balbinot attribution, and the dated review/audit records. No theorem statement changed. Verify strengthened in 5a1f5167 to reach the PRL entry and to assert the replacement scope, which the filed absence-only form did neither.
